name: Buclizine
summary: Buclizine is an antihistamine and anticholinergic of the diphenylmethylpiperazine group. It is considered to be an antiemetic, similar to meclizine.

pharmacology.text: Buclizine is an antihistamine and anticholinergic of the diphenylmethylpiperazine group.

uses.text: In the United Kingdom, buclizine is one of three drugs contained in Migraleve tablets, marketed by McNeil Healthcare for migraines.

summaryZh: 布克力嗪，別名氯苯丁嗪，商品名：安其敏。 是一種二苯基甲基匹配拉淨類抗組織胺和抗膽鹼劑。其抗組織胺H1受體作用較苯海拉明強而持久,其被視作與美克洛嗪的類似的止吐劑。在英國，氯苯丁嗪被作為偏頭痛藥物。氯苯丁嗪由叔丁醇和對三級丁基苄氯等合成。

sideEffects.en: It commonly causes drowsiness, dry mouth, blurred vision and constipation. In large amounts, anticholinergic drugs of this kind can cause confusion, delirium and a racing heart.
sideEffects.zh: 它常造成嗜睡、口乾、視力模糊與便祕。大量使用時，這類抗膽鹼藥物可能引起混亂、譫妄與心跳急促。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它常造成嗜睡、口干、视力模糊与便秘。大量使用时，这类抗胆碱药物可能引起混乱、谵妄与心跳急促。

fact.en: In the United Kingdom it is one of three ingredients in Migraleve, where it is there to settle the nausea that comes with a migraine rather than to treat the headache itself.
fact.zh: 在英國，布可立嗪是 Migraleve 三種成分之一，它的作用是緩解偏頭痛伴隨的噁心，而非治療頭痛本身。
fact.zhHans: 在英国，布可立嗪是 Migraleve 三种成分之一，它的作用是缓解偏头痛伴随的恶心，而非治疗头痛本身。
